candidate.description: Base commit 4c0b2ad plus the total-admission accounting fix in managed_rpc.rs.
candidate.runtime_change: Replace four independent waiting tickets with eight total admission tickets held for each complete admitted call, including legacy fail-fast calls and FIFO-reserved active permits. Retain four active RPC permits, original deadlines, queue eligibility, and legacy fail-fast behavior.
post_successful_run_changes: Added a reserved-but-not-yet-polled cancellation regression assertion to the unit test.
Clarified comments describing total admission and FIFO reservations.
Renamed the acceptance log waiting_rpc_limit field to additional_admitted_rpc_limit and added total_admitted_rpc_limit.
candidate.source_hash_scope: SHA256 values below identify the worktree files captured when this evidence document was written, including post-run test/comment/output-only edits. They are not represented as hashes of a preserved exact pre-run source tree or test executable.

configuration.placement: One coordinator and nine distinct loopback data processes per fresh configuration; one or two gateways in the same test process share the process-global outbound admission budget.

controlled_contention.workload: One sequential writer submits four writes while one sequential observer requests Status for the original committed ordinal 1.

overload_totals.workload: After controlled contention completes, eight concurrent Status requests race one Submit.

prior_failure.failure: Status for the original committed ordinal 1 returned Committed { ordinal: 1, visible: false } during the two-request controlled contention phase.

diagnostic.interpretation: The diagnostic identifies Capacity during Status certification. These logs alone do not establish CPU saturation or independently prove the unique internal cause; the admission handoff explanation also relies on source review and its separate deterministic regression test.

field_notes.median: For an even sample count, the arithmetic mean of the two central sorted values; pooled medians use all raw samples, not medians of case medians.
field_notes.initial_write_visible_null: Initial Submit returned Capacity or Unknown; the log does not distinguish them. Null does not mean Abort or visible=false.
field_notes.status_capacity_or_unknown: Combined error class; it does not establish that every response was an admission rejection.
field_notes.limit_field_rename: The preserved successful-run raw log uses waiting_rpc_limit=4. The corrected description is additional_admitted_rpc_limit=4 and total_admitted_rpc_limit=8. Raw records below are unchanged.

conclusion_boundaries: This is one fresh-cohort controlled contention run per configuration, not a throughput, stationary-latency, general starvation-freedom, high-availability, or large-data qualification.

The 24 reported visible writes are only the four measured contention writes per configuration. They exclude each configuration's initial write and overload write. Each completed configuration ends at ordinal 6.
The writer and observer overlap, and every measured write completes while observation remains active. The separate-gateway mode still shares one process-global outbound admission pool.

All 231 measured contention Status responses are required by the acceptance assertion to be committed ordinal 1 and visible. Status loop counts vary with relative progress; they are not independent fixed-size samples or workload throughput measurements.

The separate deliberate overload phase permits known Commit with visible=false or Capacity/Unknown. Same-request retry and final snapshot checks verify recovery at ordinal 6; they do not promise visible success under arbitrary overload.
Four active allocations and eight total admitted calls are configuration bounds, not measured peak concurrency, RSS, CPU queue size, or a bound on all application memory.
The 107.24-second test duration includes process setup, all six configurations, overload, and recovery; it is not a throughput denominator.
Four writes per configuration and growing transaction history are insufficient for statistically supported performance rankings, tail-latency claims, or a claim that width 4 is faster than width 3.
FIFO order, cancellation cleanup, and reserved-but-unpolled handoff correctness require the separate directed tests. This acceptance run shows progress in the tested workload, not universal fairness.
The reserved-cancellation assertion added after this successful run is not counted as validated by this log; its result must be recorded separately.
